photography.name: Photography
photography.blurb: Portraits, events, commercial, and lifestyle — studio or on-location.
photography.longBlurb: Portraits, events, commercial, and lifestyle photography across South Florida. Studio sessions, on-location coverage, and bilingual direction (EN/ES) on set.

videography.name: Videography
videography.blurb: Brand films, promos, and social cutdowns scoped to your shoot.
videography.longBlurb: Brand films, promos, event coverage, and social cutdowns. Story-first directing on the day so the edit comes together quickly afterward.

aerial.name: Aerial / Drone
aerial.blurb: Licensed drone capture for venues, properties, and brand films.
aerial.longBlurb: Licensed Part 107 drone capture for venues, real estate, weddings, and brand films. Cinematic moves, not just real-estate flyovers.

video-editing.name: Video Editing
video-editing.blurb: Story-first editing with professional color grading.
video-editing.longBlurb: Story-first editing and professional color grading. Bring your own footage or pair it with a shoot — delivery in any aspect ratio for any platform.

photo-editing.name: Photo Editing
photo-editing.blurb: Retouching, color, and culling — bring your RAWs.
photo-editing.longBlurb: Retouching, color, and culling. Send your RAWs; receive a polished edit ready for web, print, or social.

AboutTeaser.headline: A visual storyteller, not a drone guy.
AboutTeaser.paragraph1: South-Florida-based and bilingual (EN/ES). Esteban shoots and edits across formats — drone, camera, post — so your story stays in one pair of hands from the first frame to the final cut.
AboutTeaser.paragraph2: We make things feel like a film.
